label: Civil registry core
contains: Births, deaths, marriages, residence and the national person identifier
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: It defines who legally exists; every other register keys on it, and loss means re-enrolling the population

label: Facial biometric
contains: Facial images captured for identity documents
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Captured once at enrolment; cannot be regenerated without re-enrolling every holder

label: Fingerprint biometric
contains: Fingerprints captured for passports and ID cards where retained centrally
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Biometric templates are permanent identifiers; a foreign-compelled copy is irrevocable

label: Breeder document scans
contains: Birth certificates, naturalisation decrees and other documents that establish identity
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: The evidential root of identity; originals are often not held elsewhere

label: Document issuance history
contains: Which passports and ID cards were issued to whom, and their revocation state
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Needed to detect fraud and to revoke; partial rebuild possible from document chips in circulation

label: Digital identity credentials
contains: The national eID scheme's accounts, credentials and assurance levels
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Every online public service authenticates through it; outage or compromise stops digital government

label: Authentication audit log
contains: Records of who authenticated to which public service and when
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Evidence for fraud and abuse cases; lost or altered logs cannot be recreated

label: Electoral roll entry
contains: Who is entitled to vote where
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Integrity of elections depends on it; tampering is a direct attack on the franchise

label: State PKI and qualified trust services
contains: Root and issuing certificate authorities for government, qualified signatures and seals
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Every signed document and encrypted channel of the state chains to these keys

label: Residence and migration status
contains: Residence permits, asylum status and foreign-national registrations
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Determines legal presence and rights of non-citizens; errors are enforceable against people

label: Tax
contains: Tax assessments, returns and payment history for persons and companies
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: The state's revenue base; loss or manipulation is fiscal and legal harm at national scale

label: Customs declarations
contains: Import and export declarations and duty assessments
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Revenue, trade control and sanctions enforcement run on it

label: Benefits & pensions
contains: Entitlements, contributions and payment history for social security and state pensions
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Millions of monthly payments depend on it; contribution history is hard to reconstruct

label: Statutory health insurance
contains: Enrolment and entitlement records of the statutory health insurance scheme
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Access to care is gated on entitlement checks

label: Land & property registry
contains: Title, ownership, mortgages and cadastral parcels
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Ownership is whatever the register says; history cannot be rebuilt once lost

label: Business registry
contains: Legal entities, officers and filings
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Legal capacity of companies and the basis for contracts and procurement

label: Beneficial ownership register
contains: Ultimate beneficial owners of legal entities
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Anti-money-laundering and sanctions enforcement depend on it

label: Vehicle & licensing
contains: Vehicle registrations and driving licences
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Road safety, policing and insurance query it continuously

label: Judicial & criminal justice
contains: Criminal records, court case files and judgments
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Liberty depends on it; records of convictions and proceedings cannot be recreated

label: Police information systems
contains: Investigations, wanted persons and national police databases
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Operational policing and cross-border alerts; a foreign-compelled disclosure compromises investigations

label: Border and visa systems
contains: National parts of SIS, VIS and Entry/Exit, visa and border-crossing records
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Schengen border integrity; national copies feed EU systems

label: Firearms register
contains: Licensed firearms and their holders
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Public safety and policing

label: Official gazette and legislation
contains: Authentic text of laws and regulations
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: The legally binding version of the law must be under the state's control

label: Treasury and state accounts
contains: Budget execution, treasury payments and government accounting
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: The state's ability to pay and to account for public money

label: Government payroll and personnel
contains: Civil service and armed forces payroll and personnel records
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Pays the people who run the state; personnel files are sensitive

label: Election management and results
contains: Candidate lists, polling logistics and results tabulation systems
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Public trust in results depends on control of the systems that count them

label: Central bank systems
contains: Central bank accounts, national payment infrastructure and reserves records
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Monetary and payment stability

label: Defence command and logistics
contains: Military command-and-control, logistics and mission data
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Sovereign defence cannot run on infrastructure another state can compel or switch off

label: Intelligence services
contains: Intelligence holdings and case files
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: By definition may not be exposed to foreign jurisdiction

label: Emergency calls and public-safety radio
contains: 112/PSAP systems, emergency dispatch and TETRA/public-safety networks
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Lives depend on availability during exactly the crises that disrupt foreign providers

label: Crisis management and civil protection
contains: National crisis centre systems, alerting and continuity plans
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Must work when everything else fails

label: Electricity grid control
contains: Transmission system operator control and market systems (SCADA/EMS)
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Remote control of the grid is national-security-critical

label: Water management control
contains: Flood defence, water board and drinking-water control systems
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Physical safety of the population; for low-lying states existential

label: Health records
contains: National electronic health record or summary care record
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Most sensitive personal data category; patient history cannot be rebuilt

label: Public health surveillance
contains: Notifiable disease, vaccination and pandemic surveillance registers
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Needed exactly in cross-border crises when other states' priorities diverge

label: Education
contains: Student records, diplomas and qualifications
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Qualifications evidence careers; diploma fraud undermines professional regulation

label: Statistical microdata
contains: National statistics institute microdata and census files
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Confidential by statute; can largely be re-derived from the source registers

label: Geospatial base data
contains: Topographic maps, orthophotos and address/building base registers
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: Large volumes; mostly reproducible, but address registers are an authoritative base

label: National archives (digital)
contains: Digitally transferred government records under archive law
why_it_cannot_depend_on_foreign_control: The long-term memory of the state; destroyed records are gone
